description: This file defines the interface for the SystemInfo class within the WPEFramework project. It includes declarations for system information retrieval, environment management, and memory snapshot functionalities, along with external references and macros for module metadata.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system-related information and operations such as memory, CPU, environment variables, and system time management.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the system's memory status, providing JSON serialization of memory metrics.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force the change.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory usage.
